video_caption: The video opens with a still image of Katie Holmes and Tom Cruise smiling and looking at the camera, Katie wearing a light top with an 'S' pendant and Tom a dark jacket over a white shirt. This transitions to blurred footage, then shows Tom Cruise in sunglasses and a dark suit with Katie Holmes in a black dress, waving and smiling on a red carpet. Another shot shows them laughing and looking at each other, both wearing sunglasses. This is followed by a very close-up, intimate moment where Katie leans in to kiss Tom, her eyes closed, with an "NBC" logo visible in the bottom left corner. The scene then shifts to an interview setting, showing a man in a dark suit and patterned tie speaking and gesturing while holding papers, followed by a close-up of another man in a light-colored collared shirt, also speaking and looking thoughtful, with an "NBC" logo present. The man in the dark suit is shown again, continuing to speak, before returning to the man in the light shirt speaking expressively. The video then cuts back to Tom Cruise and Katie Holmes on a red carpet, looking at each other and smiling, with Katie wearing a dark dress and a necklace, and Tom in a dark suit. The segment concludes with a shot of Katie Holmes in a denim jacket, looking pensive behind a metal railing.

The video opens with a close-up of a woman with brown hair wearing a light blue denim-like collared shirt, looking to her right with a neutral expression against a dark, blurry background, with an "NBC" logo visible in the bottom left. This transitions to a close-up of a different woman's face, partially obscured by large, dark tortoiseshell-framed sunglasses, with her lips slightly parted and a serious expression. The scene then cuts to a third woman, possibly the first, with long brown hair, wearing a white long-sleeved top and a yellow scarf, sitting on green grass with a thoughtful gaze; part of another person in dark clothing is visible to her left, and a blurred bicycle wheel is in the background. The video then moves to an interview setting, showing a man in a dark suit and patterned tie, holding papers and a pen, speaking and gesturing to someone off-camera, followed by a shot of the interviewee, a man with light gray hair in a light blue collared shirt, speaking with an open mouth and looking slightly upwards. This interview sequence repeats briefly, and the video concludes with a woman with long dark hair, wearing a dark patterned short-sleeved top and a white knee-length skirt, walking confidently down a brightly lit office hallway with glass panels. The "NBC" logo remains present in the bottom left corner throughout the segment.

The video segment opens with a close-up of a man with short dark hair, identified as Tom Cruise, smiling slightly. This transitions to a wider shot of Tom Cruise, wearing sunglasses and a dark suit, walking on a red carpet, gesturing and smiling at a crowd, accompanied by other individuals including a woman in a dark dress and a man in a blue tie. The scene then shifts to a medium shot of a woman with long reddish-brown hair speaking, wearing a patterned top, with a textured brown, grid-like wall as her background. She is intercut with a man in a dark suit and a red and white striped tie, looking thoughtfully off-camera. Following this, a woman with dark sunglasses and a black sleeveless top, identified as Katie Holmes, is seen holding a young girl with long brown hair and a pink bow, who is burying her face in her mother's shoulder, all while outdoors. The next scene shows a woman with long brown hair, likely Mimi Rogers, sitting alone on a wooden bench outdoors, looking downcast, with green foliage in the foreground and background, and another person in a pink top walking past. The camera then focuses on a building with the words "CHURCH OF SCIENTOLOGY" clearly visible above a prominent stylized cross, indicating the building's affiliation. The segment concludes with two close-ups of the woman with long brown hair (Mimi Rogers), first looking directly at the camera with a serious, almost frowning expression against an indoor background, and then looking slightly to the side with a more neutral expression against an outdoor, green-blurred background. A small NBC logo is present in the bottom left of most frames.

The video opens with a light-skinned woman with long, wavy blonde hair and a black tank top, wearing green drop earrings and a necklace, looking off-camera against a blurry green background of trees. This transitions to a still photo of the same woman, with shorter, darker hair and red lipstick, standing next to a bearded man in a green jacket, his arm around her; an NBC logo is visible in the bottom left corner. The video then cuts back to the woman talking, smiling, with a decorative mirror visible in the background. Next, a series of shots show elements related to Scientology: a church spire with a cross against a cloudy sky, followed by a close-up of a circular emblem with an "S" design on a building, then a metal hexagonal symbol with an intertwined "S" and other shapes, and again the photo of the woman and man laughing. The woman speaks again, her expression serious. The scene shifts to an outdoor shot of a modern, multi-pointed cross on a building, then another angle showing a gold cross on a rooftop with an American flag waving in the background, and a view through window panes with green foliage in the foreground. A close-up shot shows an E-meter, a yellowish-tan device with dials and a light-up screen, connected to electrodes. This is followed by a very blurry, abstract white and grey image, perhaps representing the internal experience being audited. The woman is then shown in profile, looking down, and finally, she is seen again speaking directly to the camera, with the decorative mirror behind her, and the NBC logo periodically visible throughout the segment.

The video opens with a woman with long wavy brown hair, wearing a black tank top and a light necklace, walking away from the camera through a stone tunnel, with light visible at the end. This transitions to a wide shot of a white sign displaying "CHURCH OF SCIENTOLOGY LOS ANGELES" in blue letters, with an electronic board beneath it cycling through "EVERYONE WELCOME!" and "OPEN DAILY 9:00AM - 10:00PM www.scientology.org". The scene then cuts to a close-up of the same woman sitting indoors, speaking to an unseen interviewer with a serious expression, sometimes in profile. She articulates her concerns, stating they are "writing it all down on a piece of paper" and "keeping it in a file," and that it "feels like intelligence gathering." Following this, views of a gray church-like building with a cross-topped steeple and a stained-glass window showing the Scientology symbol (an 'S' with two triangles) are shown. A close-up of a unique cross made of three nails is also visible against a cloudy sky. The woman is then seen outdoors, looking thoughtful, before a still photo appears of her with blonder hair and red lipstick, standing next to a smiling man with long hair. This photo then fades to focus solely on the woman's face, now with a somber expression. She resumes speaking indoors, explaining she was "ostracized" and Scientologists "weren't allowed to speak to me, not even a hello." The video concludes with a bright, animated graphic of the Scientology symbol, followed by an image of a radiant sun over a curved planet, and finally, a close-up of actor Tom Cruise laughing heartily while wearing a black turtleneck.

The video begins with a close-up of Tom Cruise, wearing a black turtleneck, speaking animatedly and then breaking into a wide smile and laugh, his teeth clearly visible, while a blurry indoor background and an NBC logo are visible in the bottom left corner. The scene transitions to an outdoor shot showing Katie Holmes, wearing a grey t-shirt, blue jeans, and sunglasses, with her hair in a ponytail and a pink bra strap showing, holding hands with Tom Cruise, who is wearing a light button-up shirt, dark jeans, and sunglasses. Katie is looking down at her phone, while Tom looks forward, and a young girl, possibly their daughter Suri, in a pink top, walks beside them holding a white and black object, with green foliage in the background. A voiceover ponders what this meant for Katie as she contemplated ending her marriage, and whether she would stay with Scientology or not. The camera then focuses solely on Katie Holmes, still looking down and appearing thoughtful in the same outdoor setting, before cutting to a younger Tom Cruise in a bright pink shirt, smiling and gesturing, next to Nicole Kidman, who is wearing a blue patterned dress and a straw hat, with other people blurred in the background, likely at a public event. Throughout the video, the NBC logo remains in the bottom left corner.

The video segment opens at 0:00 with a medium shot of a man and a woman at an outdoor event. The man, wearing a bright pink button-up shirt, smiles broadly and gestures with his right hand as he looks at the woman beside him. The woman, with long blonde hair styled in two braids, wears a blue dress with a white floral pattern and a beige straw hat. She is also smiling and looking at the man. Several other people, mostly out of focus, are visible in the background. The NBC logo is visible in the bottom left corner. At 0:02, the scene transitions to the same man and woman, now seated and wearing sunglasses. The man, in a black shirt, has his hands clasped in front of him and looks straight ahead with a focused expression. The woman, in a cream-colored blazer over a white top, also looks straight ahead with a serious, unsmiling expression. They appear to be in an audience, with blurred figures in the background. The scene changes again at 0:06 to a medium close-up of a woman with long, wavy blonde hair, wearing a black sleeveless top and a silver necklace. She is speaking directly to the camera, her expression alternating between serious and slightly thoughtful as she explains something about an "SP." The background is an indoor setting with a light-colored wall, a mirror, and a decorative lamp visible behind her. The NBC logo remains in the bottom left corner throughout this shot.

The video segment opens with a smiling Tom Cruise in a dark suit and white shirt, posing for a photo between a young boy with short dark hair in a striped shirt and patterned tie, and a young girl with light brown hair in a dark top, both also smiling. The scene then transitions to a man with glasses and a striped shirt sitting at a desk, typing on a laptop, surrounded by books and binders on shelves above him, in what appears to be an office setting. He is next seen wearing a suit and tie, speaking seriously to the camera in a room with a fireplace and a bookshelf in the background. Finally, the video shows a woman with her hair up, wearing a red-strapped top, hugging a young girl with long brown hair who is holding two white, soft objects and burying her face into the woman's shoulder, appearing upset or sleepy. A text overlay, featuring the Twitter logo, reads: "Chat Live with Josh Mankiewicz" and "@JoshMankiewicz #dateline," encouraging viewers to participate in a live online discussion.

The video opens with a red-haired woman with green eyes, wearing a patterned top, speaking in what appears to be a sound-proofed room, followed by a shot of a man in a suit gesturing while talking to someone off-screen. The red-haired woman then speaks again with a determined expression. A gold "COMING UP" text overlay appears on a dark, blurred background, transitioning to a scene where a dark-haired woman (Katie Holmes) in a denim jacket and dark leggings, carrying a red bag, exits a building, smiling slightly as she is swarmed by paparazzi and photographers, with one man running ahead. The red-haired woman then speaks animatedly, followed by a brief montage showing Katie Holmes and Tom Cruise smiling, and another woman in sunglasses waving to a crowd. The "DATELINE" title card in gold with the NBC logo is displayed, leading to a news anchor in a grey suit and glasses speaking in front of a blurred city skyline. The video concludes with a repeat of Katie Holmes being surrounded by paparazzi.

The video opens with a woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a light blue collared shirt, being escorted into a dark car amidst a bustling crowd, including a man in a brown jacket. The scene transitions to the same woman, now wearing sunglasses, holding a young girl in a pink and white floral dress, with another girl in a green top beside them, surrounded by people. A brief shot shows the back of a man's head, followed by a young girl with long brown hair, wearing a grey dress with pink trim, holding a stuffed animal and yellow fruit, walking quickly while holding a man's hand. Next, a woman in a dark top and light jeans, holding a coffee cup, walks hand-in-hand with a man in a dark turtleneck and sunglasses on a sidewalk. They smile at the camera before the video shows a close-up of a dark plaque with gold lettering that reads "CHURCH OF SCIENTOLOGY Celeb Inter" (Church of Scientology Celebrity International). The couple is then seen walking again, holding hands, with the woman still holding her coffee. The scene shifts to an indoor office where a man with glasses and a striped shirt is typing on a laptop, with a bookshelf visible behind him. He then looks directly at the camera, speaking about the woman's behavior, saying she was "escaping from Alcatraz, from an open prison" and that it was a "very meticulously organized escape." The video concludes with the woman in a navy polo shirt, amidst a large crowd, being shielded by a man in a dark shirt and sunglasses as onlookers hold up phones and cameras, with a "MOBILE" sign in the background.

The video segment features a series of short clips and still images related to Katie Holmes and Tom Cruise. It begins with a still image of three smiling individuals sitting on a couch: an older man in a light suit and tie, an older woman with short grey hair in a light dress holding a drink, and a younger woman with dark hair in a light top. This is followed by a man with glasses and a striped shirt speaking in an indoor setting with a bookshelf. A white sign for "CHURCH OF SCIENTOLOGY LOS ANGELES" is shown, with a digital message board reading "COME IN TODAY." Another street sign, "L. Ron Hubbard Way 1400," appears. The man with glasses is shown speaking again. Then, Katie Holmes is seen getting into a black car, surrounded by paparazzi. Establishing shots of a tall apartment building, its golden entrance, and people walking by lead into a black SUV pulling into an underground garage with a "PARK" sign. A man in a hat is then interviewed by reporters holding microphones. An older, bald man in a suit and red tie is shown speaking directly to the camera. Katie Holmes and Tom Cruise are then seen together on a purple carpet at an event, and later walking and smiling, with Tom Cruise gesturing. A close-up shows Katie Holmes looking downwards with a slight smile, wearing a green top. A woman with long reddish-brown hair is shown speaking, followed by a man in a suit and striped tie speaking, and then the woman again. The segment concludes with a close-up of a smiling Tom Cruise wearing aviator sunglasses, a white shirt, and a dark jacket.

The video begins with a still, close-up image of Tom Cruise smiling, wearing sunglasses, a white collared shirt, and a dark jacket. The NBC peacock logo is visible in the bottom left corner. This transitions to a shot of Katie Holmes, dressed in a green button-up top, smiling as she exits a vehicle, holding a stack of pink papers. A man's arm, possibly a bodyguard's, is seen assisting her. Next, a man with light brown hair, wearing a light blue collared shirt, is shown from the chest up, speaking and looking off-camera, with a serious expression. The scene then returns to Tom Cruise, shown from the chest up, wearing a white t-shirt and a dark green jacket, with a somber or contemplative expression. The video concludes with Katie Holmes walking in a dimly lit area, possibly at an event, wearing a pink or purple top and smiling, with blurred figures in the background. The NBC logo remains consistent throughout the video.

The video begins with a shot of a woman, identified as Katie Holmes, with long dark hair, wearing a purple top, smiling and looking to her right against a background that appears to be a red carpet banner with partial text visible, possibly "JILL" or "JACK JILL." The scene then transitions to a different woman with reddish-brown hair and green eyes, wearing a patterned top, speaking directly to the camera with a textured, grid-patterned wall behind her, suggesting an interview setting. Following this, Katie Holmes reappears, now wearing a black top, smiling broadly and linking arms with Tom Cruise, who is wearing sunglasses and a black suit, both looking towards the camera at what seems to be a public event like a premiere, with a crowd visible in the background. The final shot blurs the image of Katie Holmes and Tom Cruise. Throughout the video, the NBC logo is present in the bottom left corner.

The video begins with a close-up of actor Tom Cruise, with short dark hair and wearing a dark suit, smiling and embracing a woman with dark hair pulled back, wearing a black top and silver necklace. They exchange smiles, suggesting a tender moment. This transitions to a blurred shot of a family walking, followed by a clearer view of a woman (dark hair, sunglasses, light blue t-shirt, blue jeans) and a man (dark hair, sunglasses, light blue button-up shirt, blue jeans) holding hands with a young girl (long dark hair, pink and white striped shirt, light skirt) as they walk outdoors. Next, a close-up shows a car's RPM gauge, with the needle moving, indicating acceleration. The scene then shifts to night, featuring a red muscle car with black stripes on the hood, driven by a man. White text appears on a black screen, stating "TOM CRUISE". This is followed by several action shots of Tom Cruise in a dark shirt in a gritty, wet urban environment at night, engaging in a fight with several men. He is seen punching, kicking, and standing over fallen opponents, with a red car visible in the background. The mood darkens with a low-angle shot of Cruise looking up. The video then cuts to an interview with a woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a patterned top, who speaks about Tom Cruise's charisma and talent as a movie star. The final scenes show Tom Cruise, smiling, in various public settings: first, in a dark suit at night; then, in a red car with "SALEEN" visible on the windshield, smiling as a uniformed officer stands nearby; and finally, wearing sunglasses and a pink shirt under a dark suit, smiling and waving to a crowd of fans, some of whom are taking photos. The woman's interview returns briefly before the video ends abruptly with a static-like sound.

The video segment displays a white document, possibly a letter, with a red circular logo at the top left, sitting on a dark, textured surface. At the bottom left of the screen, the green and yellow NBC logo is visible. Overlapping the right side of the document, a light gray rectangular text box appears with the text: "This is a personal family matter and the Church respects their privacy." A few seconds later, a second identical light gray rectangular text box slides in from the right, positioned below the first one, displaying the text: "The Church has no comment on any individuals." The document itself has several paragraphs of text, but they are too small to be legible, and no specific individuals are visible or mentioned other than through the text on the screen.

The video opens with a quick montage of Katie Holmes in New York City, first being escorted through a crowd by a man, then appearing to shop for groceries, followed by clips of her entering/exiting an attorney's office, and finally, her daughter, Suri, and another girl enjoying ice cream in a cafe. A woman with long reddish-brown hair is then shown speaking directly to the camera, emphasizing the importance of Suri having a "normal childhood" as "normal as life can be for a movie star." This is followed by screenshots of online headlines, including "Mail Online" reporting "Suri clings to mother Katie Holmes as she shows strain of parents' divorce on trip to museum," and "Hollywood Life" with the headline "Katie Holmes Is A Great Mom - She's Going Through Hell For Suri's Sake." Another forum discussion headline asks "Katie Holmes - Great mom or greatest mom?", and other online comments praising Katie are shown. Two different men then provide commentary on Katie Holmes's actions, with one stating, "being a good mother, doing the right thing," and the other adding, "fighting the power." The video then transitions to a series of past clips of Katie Holmes and Tom Cruise looking happy together at various public events, including red carpets and what appears to be a promotional tour, holding hands, smiling, and waving to crowds. The final clips of Tom Cruise show him, sometimes with sunglasses, smiling and interacting with fans, often surrounded by security, suggesting a contrast to the current situation. The segment then switches to a male news anchor in a dark suit, blue patterned tie, and glasses, standing against a blurred city skyline at night. He discusses how the split of Scientology's "most famous couple" has placed the church under a new spotlight, introducing an upcoming "Rock Center with Brian Williams" segment about those who tried to break away from Scientology. A promotional graphic for "Rock Center with Brian Williams" appears, displaying "ALL NEW. ALL SUMMER THURSDAY 10/9c" (ALL NEW. ALL SUMMER THURSDAY 10/9 central) and the NBC logo. The news anchor concludes by reiterating the broadcast time.

A light-skinned man with short dark hair and glasses is shown from the chest up, speaking directly to the camera with a serious expression. He is wearing a grey suit jacket over a light blue collared shirt and a dark blue tie with diagonal stripes. Behind him, a dark background with blurred, distant city lights suggests a nighttime urban setting. A small, almost imperceptible NBC logo is visible in the bottom left corner of the screen. At 00:01, the scene abruptly cuts to a solid black screen.
